Privacy Policy

Effective Date: January 1, 2026

At SHAIVIKA IT TECHNOLOGIES ("we", "our", or "us"), we value your privacy and are committed to safeguarding the personal and business information you share with us through our website and services.

1. Information We Collect

When you submit a project inquiry, request a consultation, or communicate with us, we may collect your name, business email address, company name, country, and project description. We collect this information solely to evaluate project requirements and communicate with you.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used strictly to provide consulting assessments, deliver software development proposals, fulfill service agreements, and provide technical support. We never sell, rent, or trade your contact or business information to third parties.

3. Data Security

We implement strict technical and operational security controls to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, or alteration of your communications and project data.

4. Contact Regarding Privacy

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out directly at shaivikagroups@gmail.com.
